summary: US pickup slots for the iPhone Duo still show up rarely and vanish within minutes, and online delivery runs to late January. For a 256GB unlocked pickup in NJ, a fast alert and tapping it right away is the realistic path.

items.title: New online orders quote late-January delivery
items.summary: About 30 minutes after preorders opened, Apple's US delivery estimate hit January 25, 2027; Verizon has also flagged an unexpected preorder shipping delay.

items.title: Tracker logs another brief US restock late Saturday morning
items.summary: Manzana Tracker listed its latest US back-in-stock moment at 11:16 AM ET on Oct 24; minutes later none of the 266 stores it checks had pickup stock. Its data is labeled beta.

items.title: Pickup reservations reopened for about five minutes
items.summary: US and Canada pickup slots appeared around 8:10 AM ET on Oct 24 and were gone about five minutes later; most stores never showed any.

items.title: Apple caps US online orders at two per customer
items.summary: Apple's US store reportedly blocks checkout with more than two Duos in the bag, per a Reddit user screenshot (a user report). Insiders also say production has been increased.

items.title: Restock timing has no clear schedule
items.summary: Reporting suggests store restocks tend to arrive midday to early evening local time and sell out in minutes; Apple publishes no schedule.

items.title: Launch-day walk-in stock sold out fast; carriers had units
items.summary: Apple Stores ran out within minutes at some locations on Oct 23, while Best Buy and the big three carriers still listed both colors at the time.

items.title: Apple confirmed limited walk-in supply for launch
items.summary: Apple said US stores would get a small walk-in allotment on Oct 23 and pointed online shoppers to check pickup again on Oct 24.
